purpose.en: Stretches your inner thighs and the backs of your thighs.

text.zh: 背拉长，上身慢慢往前倾
坐在垫子上，两腿伸直分开，脚尖和膝盖朝上。
text.en: Sit with your legs straight and wide, toes and kneecaps up.

text.zh: 屁股往后推一点坐实，从胯往前倒。
text.en: Sit firmly on your sit bones and tip forward from your hips.

text.zh: 手在前面地上慢慢往前走，别用背去够。
text.en: Walk your hands forward slowly. Don't reach with your back.

commonErrors.en: Rounding your back and just dropping your head.

commonErrors.zh: 脚尖往前倒，膝盖跟着往里翻
commonErrors.en: Toes falling forward and knees rolling in.

commonErrors.zh: 手使劲往前拽，膝盖后面扯着疼
commonErrors.en: Pulling forward with your hands until the backs of your knees hurt.

cautions.zh: 拉的地方疼就少往前倾点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If the stretch hurts, don't lean as far. Stop if it still hurts.
